lead.headline: Federal Election Commission totals for House Republicans' campaign arm skip its Sept 2024 report: $40.72M of spending
lead.number: The NRCC's (C00075820) 2024 line is $21.88M off its own cash math because its Sept 2024 monthly ($40.72M spent, $18.85M raised) is missing from FEC totals; its own filings balance to the cent.
lead.watch_out: The NRCC story is dead: its own filings reconcile to the cent. The error is the FEC's roll-up, and API /totals matches the bulk file, so it can't serve as the outside check. One committee, no story until the FEC comments.

The records (rows) for each committee contains information, updated nightly, based upon reports either received (for electronic filings) or computerized (for paper filings from small committees) through 7 pm the previous day. These totals also incorporate any changes made by committees if any report covering the period is amended. As part of each financial report, committees must provide a summary of their financial activity in each filing, and these summaries for each reporting period are included here.
